cases.name: test_geneList
cases.what: The data's own test, from its README: 450 ENDPU IDs

cases.name: test_geneList_values
cases.what: Every ENDPU ID, each with a value in a second column

cases.name: repeats
cases.what: Repeated IDs, each mapped each time: a subfamily, a family, a stored NOHIT and an ID not in the file (REFMAP-4)

cases.name: case-and-suffixes
cases.what: No folding or stripping: lower and mixed case, an isoform and a version (REFMAP-1)

cases.name: first-unmapped
cases.what: A first ID that isn't in the file, then a stored NOHIT: the service answers both; only the website dropped a first NOHIT as a header

cases.name: other-organism
cases.what: IDs from ARAVE's file, none of them in ENDPU's

cases.name: punctuation
cases.what: IDs with punctuation, looked up as they are, and an ID of 64 characters, the longest the API takes

cases.name: list-endings
cases.what: A list with CRLF endings, a carriage return inside an ID, more columns, and no line feed at the end: every \r is removed, and the first field taken

cases.name: repeated-id
cases.what: An ID on two lines of a file: the last line wins (REFMAP-2)

cases.name: crlf
cases.what: A file with CRLF endings: each value keeps its \r, NOHIT\r included (REFMAP-3)

cases.name: no-second-field
cases.what: Later lines after a line that gave the ID a value: A1 alone, with no tab, gives no PANTHER ID; B2 and a tab gives an empty one, as `my ($id, $pthr) = split` keeps a trailing empty field

cases.name: empty-second-field
cases.what: An empty second field before a third: an empty PANTHER ID

cases.name: third-field
cases.what: More fields after the PANTHER ID: the second field alone

cases.name: stored-nohit
cases.what: A stored NOHIT and an absent ID: both no PANTHER ID (REFMAP-6)

cases.name: no-final-line-feed
cases.what: A file whose last line has no line feed

cases.name: empty-line
cases.what: An empty line among the IDs (REFMAP-10)

cases.name: space-in-id
cases.what: Two IDs on one line, separated by a space

cases.name: id-too-long
cases.what: An ID of 65 characters

cases.name: non-ascii-id
cases.what: An ID with a Latin-1 byte, outside printable ASCII

cases.name: unknown-organism
cases.what: An organism refmap has no data for (REFMAP-9)

cases.name: missing-file
cases.what: A classification file that isn't there: cases/missing.classification is never created (REFMAP-9)
